agentUpdateInstructions: Back up first: stop your development process by PID and rer export --output exports/vector.rer locally, or take a backup with the authenticated Base transfer client for a hosted copy, and validate recovery in isolated empty resources. Pull v0.5.0, pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, then rer setup locally or rer deploy --environment <name> hosted with the existing environment and custody files: the 67 new migrations (0075_workspace_roles.sql through 0141_business_retired.sql) apply in filename order. @runeditrun/rer moves from 0.2.77 to 0.2.134. MAIL_PROVIDER=none is new: it needs no sender or key, nothing is sent, and the owner signs in with rer signin; an existing mail configuration is unchanged.
publicReleaseNotes: Vector 0.5.0 brings the release up to Run Edit Run 0.2.134 and lets a Business set Vector up with mail off: MAIL_PROVIDER=none needs no sender or key, nothing is sent, and the owner signs in with rer signin. Since 0.4.1 it adds roles (Owner, Admin, Member, Viewer, Guest) with team membership and permissions, private teams and sub-teams, member suspension and reactivation, guest invitations and team join requests, a workspace audit, notification channels with Slack threads and initiative bindings, email intake, GitHub automation, commits and deployments, releases and release notes, initiatives, documents with mentions and issue references, dashboards, calendar feeds, project templates and dependencies, issue templates, reactions and start dates, custom fields, resolution SLAs, automation rules, leadership digests, report export schedules, OAuth apps, webhook subscriptions, error-tracker connections, import aliases, and the agent door with Business settings and people.
